change_rule: September 27's four additions from its package at the same specifications; the capital return at the case's values; the change from September 27 line by line, v4_<line> = -(effect - September 27's effect), social security and Medicare split into the accrual the pension switch charges and the benefits it no longer charges, and the production grid's change in P and F
v5_change_rule: every September 29 part from September 29's package at the same specifications, and the capital return at September 29's values (capital_bn); the lineage's change from September 29 line by line, v5_<line> = -(effect - September 29's effect), social security and Medicare split into the accrual the set charges, the benefits the cash set charges and minus the benefits the set does not charge, the production grid's change in P and F, and the capital return's change by component (v5_capital_bn)
v6_change_rule: every October 5 part from October 5's package at the same specifications (as --case oct05); the items' change from October 5 item by item, in the payload's order (the lineage item first, then the edit sets in registry order), each step the package's caseOf(v5, the items so far) less the step before at the same specification; on each line the union's part (path union) is the change of the union twin (September 29's model plus audit row 8's change plus the edit sets' union_ parts and national totals) and the added people's (path lineage) the rest, v6_<item>_<path>_<line>, social security and Medicare split per path into the accrual the set charges, the benefits the cash set charges and minus the benefits the set does not charge; the production grid's change (the lineage item's only); the capital return's change by component and path (v6_capital_bn)

allocation.rule: the group total is the change for all other residents, read at the personal allocation: the case's specifications are v6's with allocation personal (0-31 in v6's numbering, 32 per fill-in method), and the band is their minimum and maximum, each method's, averaged
allocation.reason: sharing splits each SPM unit's taxes and person-level benefits among its members and non-members alike, so in mixed units it credits the group with non-members' taxes; the headline counts the change for everyone else, which the personal allocation measures (the v6 assumption review, item 1: v6's low end, specification 48, is shared)
allocation.shared_kept_for: distribution inside the group and comparisons between groups, where both sides share alike: SHARED_SPECS (32-63), specsFor / central with {allocation: "shared"}, the row shared_allocation and summary.json v7.companions.shared_allocation

specifications.numbering: v6's: index = allocation x 32 + normalization x 16 + share x 8 + school x 4 + reading x 2 + uc, so 16 and 11 keep their names

allocation.child_credits: the term the personal allocation still misses (non-member filers' credits for member children, and the reverse) is item child_credits

v7_change_rule: The band uses the package's 32 personal specifications in v6's numbering. Earlier steps are evaluated directly at those specifications, not compared to their summaries' shared low end. New edit sets use tagged union/lineage components, named v6_<item>_<path>_<line> for the existing debt consumer; job capital takes its whole responsive targets from ITEM_DETAIL rather than its cell shifts. Every new component sums to its line's evaluated move at 1e-9.
